name: Prompt engine help
description: Help mode entries (help@1) for the Prompt engine control panel.
author: Brett

entries.title: Prompt engine
entries.text: Rules that watch every event (builds, UI Review, held calls, merge clashes, the watchdog, schedules, voice, webhooks), ask you what to do, and run tools, macros and pipelines on your answer. Tabs: Events, Builder, Macros, Pipelines, Waiting, History, Registry.

entries.title: New rule
entries.text: Opens the builder with an empty rule: pick an event on the left, set filters and conditions, say what to ask, then what runs on each answer.

entries.title: From a template
entries.text: Ready-made rules for the common cases (UI Review pop-up, build failed, held call veto, merge clash, model upgrade, watchdog, service down, daily digest, build shipped). Pick one, then tap Add; edit it afterwards like any rule.

entries.title: Add the template
entries.text: Creates a rule from the picked template, switched on.

entries.title: Run tick
entries.text: Runs the once-a-minute tick now: prompts past their deadline time out (a veto runs, a pick takes its default) and schedules that are due fire.

entries.title: Refresh
entries.text: Reads the rules, macros, pipelines and waiting prompts again.

entries.title: Rule on / off
entries.text: A rule that is off stays here but never fires. Turn it on again any time.

entries.title: Edit
entries.text: Opens this rule, macro or pipeline in its editor.

entries.title: Test (dry run)
entries.text: Fires the rule with a sample event, limits ignored, running nothing: tells you whether it fires, what it would ask and what would run on each answer. The details land in History.

entries.title: Delete
entries.text: Removes the rule, macro or pipeline for good (the history stays).

entries.title: Add rule
entries.text: Saves the new rule. It is on right away unless you switch it off.

entries.title: Save
entries.text: Saves your changes to this rule.

entries.title: Test (dry run)
entries.text: Saves nothing, runs nothing: shows whether the saved rule fires on a sample event and what it would ask.

entries.title: Cancel
entries.text: Leaves the editor without saving.

entries.title: JSON
entries.text: Shows the rule as prompt-event@1 JSON to edit by hand; Apply JSON puts it back into the form.

entries.title: Apply JSON
entries.text: Reads the JSON into the form. Not valid JSON is refused with the reason.

entries.title: Add filter
entries.text: A quick equality filter on one of the event's fields: the rule only fires when the field has that value.

entries.title: Add condition
entries.text: A condition on a field: equal, not, one of, contains, matches, greater or less than (thresholds), present or missing. All conditions must hold.

entries.title: Add option
entries.text: Another option for a pick prompt; each option gets its own list of actions on the right.

entries.title: Add action
entries.text: Something to run on this answer: a tool (any plugin command), a console command, a macro, a pipeline, a build change, a notification, or another event. Inputs read the event with {{field}}.

entries.title: Remove
entries.text: Takes this row off the rule.

entries.title: New macro
entries.text: A macro is a saved sequence of actions with parameters; rules and pipelines run it by name.

entries.title: Save macro
entries.text: Saves the macro; rules that run it pick up the change next time.

entries.title: New pipeline
entries.text: A pipeline runs stages in order; a stage with a gate waits for your answer before it goes on.

entries.title: Add stage
entries.text: Another stage at the end of the pipeline.

entries.title: Gate
entries.text: When on, the pipeline stops here and asks you (approve, veto or text) before this stage runs.

entries.title: Save pipeline
entries.text: Saves the pipeline.

entries.title: How to run
entries.text: A pipeline runs from a rule's action "Run a pipeline", from a macro, or from the API / CLI.

entries.title: Approve
entries.text: Answers this prompt with approve: its approve actions run now.

entries.title: Deny
entries.text: Answers with deny: its deny actions run (often nothing).

entries.title: Later
entries.text: Shelves the prompt: it stays in the list without a deadline until you answer.

entries.title: Send
entries.text: Sends your text as the answer.

entries.title: Show
entries.text: Filters the history by what happened: fired, skipped (and why), asked, answered, expired, ran, failed, dry runs, keys needed.

entries.title: Open the control panel
entries.text: Goes to Builds → Prompt engine.

entries.title: Prompts waiting
entries.text: Opens the Waiting tab: everything that still needs your answer.

entries.title: Prompt engine settings
entries.text: Counts, the control panel link, and how the same commands are reached by REST, MCP, the CLI and voice; install and uninstall below.

entries.title: Prompt engine
entries.text: Opens the Prompt engine control panel.

entries.title: Prompts waiting…
entries.text: Opens the Waiting tab of the Prompt engine.

entries.title: New prompt rule…
entries.text: Opens the Prompt engine builder with an empty rule.

entries.title: Rule (prompt-event@1)
entries.text: The rule as prompt-event@1 JSON: trigger, when, limits, ask and on. Edit it here and tap Apply JSON to put it back into the form.

entries.title: Is
entries.text: How the field is compared: equal, not, one of, contains, matches a pattern, greater or less than (a threshold), present or missing. Only the operators that fit the field type are offered.

entries.title: Cooldown (s)
entries.text: After the rule fires, nothing fires again for this many seconds, whatever comes in. 0 = no cooldown.

entries.title: Dedupe key
entries.text: A template such as {{build.id}}: the same key asks only once within the dedupe window, so one failing build makes one prompt.

entries.title: Dedupe window (s)
entries.text: How long a dedupe key is remembered, in seconds. 0 = a day.

entries.title: Max per hour
entries.text: At most this many fires an hour; the rest are skipped and show in History as rate. 0 = no cap.

entries.title: Option id
entries.text: The short id of this option (letters, digits, dashes). Voice and the API pick by id, number or label; the actions on the right are listed under it.

entries.title: Countdown (s)
entries.text: For a veto: seconds before it runs by itself unless you deny it (at least 5). For a pick: seconds before the default option is taken; 0 = no deadline.

entries.title: Parameters
entries.text: Names the macro takes, comma separated. Steps read them as {{params.name}}; a rule or pipeline passes them when it runs the macro.

entries.title: Stage title
entries.text: What this stage is called in the pipeline list, the history and the gate prompt.

entries.title: Gate kind
entries.text: How you are asked before this stage runs: approve / deny, a veto countdown that runs unless you stop it, or a text answer.

entries.title: Gate title
entries.text: The question you see when the pipeline reaches this stage; {{params.name}} reads the pipeline parameters.

entries.title: Answer
entries.text: Your text answer to this prompt; the rule reads it as {{answer.text}}.

steps.say: Events lists your rules: what fires them, what they ask, what runs on each answer.
Start from a template, or tap New rule and pick an event on the left of the builder.
Waiting holds every prompt that still needs you; you can also answer by voice: approve it, pick option 2.
